briefdescription.para: Canonical JIT type for an arbitrary Ecstasy type represents a type that JIT compiler uses for variables and properties that hold non-primitive instances of the corresponding type.

detaileddescription.para: The cannonical type is always either TerminalTypeConstant with a isSingleUnderlyingClass or a ParameterizedTypeConstant with non-parameterized canonical types as parameters.

For every non-parameterized type of single underlyin class (regardless of access and immutability modifications) the canonical type is the corrsponding TerminalTypeConstant. For a parameterized type with parameters of non-primitive types with trivial constraints, the canonical type is also the corrsponding TerminalTypeConstant; otherwise it s the parameterized type with parameters of primitive or constraint types. For union or difference types, the canonical type is ConstantPool#typeObject(). For intersection types, it's the most specific canonical type across the contributing types.

simplesect.para: a canonical Jit type where all the type parameters are either primitive types or corresponding formal type constraint types
